summary: A send the provider took for a moment did not go: a read found it failed or cancelled, or the last read of it after its moment had passed still found it waiting, and it is overdue; said once per send, and never of a send the campaign's own cancel took back.

key.description: The work item that made the send: one line per send.

plugin.description: The plugin that answered the read.

reference.description: The provider's reference for the send, as the send returned it.

state.description: `failed`: the provider took the send and it did not go. `cancelled`: it was cancelled before it went, not by a cancel of the campaign's. `overdue`: the last read the runtime made of it, `Dispatcher:DeferredReadOverdueSeconds` or more after its moment, still found it waiting, and no read found what became of it.

failure_code.description: The provider's own code for the failure where it is one word of its vocabulary, uninterpreted, never a server's text or the provider's sentence; null where it gives none or gives something else, and for a send that is overdue.

moment.description: The moment the provider took the send for, as the send's own result or arguments named it.

cancelled_at.description: When the send was cancelled, or null where it was not or the provider gives no moment.

read_work_item.description: The work item that read the send's status.
